tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background and the desktop gutter around the 430px column.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, header, modals, inputs. Not in your Coolors palettes (all are mid-tone); a near-white kept so cards lift off the canvas.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tab, selected chips. Text on it is surface (6:1).

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of primary and deep spines in the room scene.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, unselected chips, tinted panels.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass-tan accent: icons, progress fill, large text. Only about 2.5:1 on canvas, so never small text.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Warm highlight: links on large text, badges, error/attention tint with surface text.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Reading-match badge, Reading status, success states. Text on it is surface (5.5:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on canvas or surface (about 7:1 on canvas).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, captions, metadata (about 4.3:1 on canvas: use 14px+ or bold).

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Empty cover fill, skeletons. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, dividers, shelf edges.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers inside surface cards.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill and inactive icons.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The pixel outline: 2px round buttons, cards, tags, inputs and modals, and their hard shadow. My Room's outline colour.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen title in the shared header.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Modal titles, book title on details.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between book covers in a carousel.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations, modal padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Book covers only.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, inputs: square, the pixel look.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and bottom sheets: square, the pixel look.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges and tags: square too. Avatars use their own circle.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards, buttons and floating panels: a hard shadow with no blur, in outline.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and the floating Currently Reading card: the same hard shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: A pressed button, sunk into its shadow.
